simple.meaning: שְׁמַרְיָה (Shᵉmaryâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “Shemarjah , the name of four Israelites.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שְׁמַרְיָה (H8114) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Chronicles 12:6, with occurrences in 1 Chronicles, 2 Chronicles, Ezra.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁמַרְיָה (H8114) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שְׁמַרְיָה (H8114) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שְׁמַרְיָה (Shᵉmaryâh) / H8114 is traced through 1 Chronicles 12:6, 2 Chronicles 11:19, Ezra 10:32, Ezra 10:41 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
